leadText:
Noelle (Japanese: ノア Noa) is a character of the day who appeared in Strategy Begins at Home!. She is one of Johanna's students as well as a friend of 's.

Prior to Dawn's return to Twinleaf Town with and , Noelle had been staying at Dawn's home for the past week so she could train to become a Pokémon Coordinator under Johanna's guidance. Brock fell head over heels with her and proceeded to flirt with her throughout the day. He was eventually stopped not only by his , but by Noelle's overprotective as well.

Noelle showed herself to be keen to learn. She was interested in Brock's recipes and thoroughly enjoyed Dawn and Johanna's .
